theme:fonts-icons.summary:
Built both asset pipelines and verified them end to end.

Fonts (tools/fonts/build-fonts.py, python3 + fontTools 4.60 + brotli, no pip): downloads the google/fonts OFL variable TTFs + OFL.txt into tools/.cache/fonts/ (gitignored; --skip-download for offline, --force to refetch), instances (Fraunces SOFT=0/WONK=0, opsz 9-144 + wght 300-800 kept; Inter opsz=14, wght 400-700), subsets to the GF latin range keeping default features + ss01-20/onum/lnum/tnum/pnum/case and all variation tables, writes WOFF2, copies OFL notices, writes _fonts.scss with a size table, and self-verifies (axes, tagline glyphs, ASCII, features). Output: fraunces-var.woff2 67,636 B; fraunces-italic-var.woff2 81,864 B; inter-var.woff2 41,008 B (190,508 B total). Builds are byte-reproducible.

Icons (tools/build-icons.mjs): 39 lucide-static 1.44.0 symbols (#hk9-icon-<name>) in assets/dist/icons.svg plus icons.json and docs/licenses/LICENSE-lucide.txt. facebook/instagram/youtube/linkedin do not exist in lucide-static (brand icons were removed upstream) and were skipped.

Verified in Chromium/WebKit/Firefox via Playwright: all faces load, weight/italic axes measurably differ, all 39 icons render; the running WP stack serves the files with correct MIME types.

plugin:importer.verdict: CHANGES REQUIRED before importing the real payload. The importer matches the validated design and ARCHITECTURE §8 naming (map table, meta mirrors, tokens, step order, REST/CLI surface, rule shapes); security (nonces, manage_options+unfiltered_html gates, realpath containment, prepared SQL, script purge, protected dirs) is sound; php -l (8.5) clean; debug.log empty; 5 of the claimed tests re-run by me hold. But three real defects exist, two reproduced on the running stack: (1) the MIME allowlist rejects mp4/docx that the plan requires and the real payload contains, and that failure cascades into the ENTIRE option:hk9_settings record failing (seen in real-payload dry-run log 20260911-132232); (2) template writes via meta_input are silently reverted by wp_update_post (re-import/--overwrite template changes never land, readback hides it); (3) a page whose content fails to bake is published empty and served 200.

findings.issue: allowed_mimes() is a hand-rolled 6-type list (jpeg/png/gif/webp/avif/pdf). The plan (Phase 2: 'PDFs/docx/mp4') and the real payload include video/mp4 (live:media:2881) and a .docx (live:media:3745). Real-payload dry run 20260911-132232 log: both rejected -> posts_content live:page:3742 fails -> 'option:hk9_settings Depends on failed record live:page:3742' -> the whole settings option is not imported (links.obedience references that page). One disallowed document silently loses all site settings.
findings.fix: Base the allowlist on get_allowed_mime_types() minus svg/heic (or add video/mp4, application/msword, docx/xlsx/pptx). In Options::process, resolve tokens per top-level key/leaf and warn + drop (post_id=0) an unresolvable link instead of failing the record; same per-key degradation for menus is optional.

findings.issue: _wp_page_template is written only through meta_input. wp_update_post() merges the post's existing page_template (WP_Post::__get returns the raw meta, including the literal 'default'), and wp_insert_post (post.php L5160-5171) re-writes _wp_page_template with that OLD value after meta_input. Reproduced: page with 'default' + apply(about.php) -> stays default, returns true; page with home.php + apply(about.php) -> stays home.php, returns true. Readback then records the old value as 'db', so later runs report skip: template changes on re-import and --overwrite of an editor's template are silently lost. When the old template file is absent the same call returns WP_Error AFTER the row was updated (partial write, spurious conflict next run). First import only works because stubs have no template meta.
findings.fix: Set $args['page_template'] = $v (validated by the existing theme_page_templates whitelist), and whitelist BOTH the current meta value and the new one in that filter; or update_post_meta($id,'_wp_page_template',$v) after wp_update_post (not a revisioned key). Add a fixture test that changes a template on re-import.

findings.issue: posts_hierarchy publishes the stub before posts_content has baked its content. If any token in content/*.html is unresolvable (failed attachment, as with live:page:3742 on the real payload) the page stays published with post_content ''. Reproduced with a fixture page: 'orphan #400 status=publish content_len=0', GET /mini-orphan/ -> 200. Defeats judge fix #2's intent (nothing half-imported public).
findings.fix: In desired_hierarchy (or PostsHierarchy::process) extract tokens from the record's content file and fail the record when any depends on a failed key or cannot resolve (skip post_url kinds); alternatively keep post_status=draft until PostsContent succeeds and apply the final status there.

findings.issue: desired[group] = deep_merge(current[group], payload[group]) makes the 'src' hash depend on the CURRENT value. After an editor edits any sibling key in a group (e.g. contact.hours), db hash != stored db and src == db, so every later run reports the group as 'conflict' forever although nothing needs applying; with --overwrite nothing is applied but the noise disappears.
findings.fix: Reconcile per leaf (or hash only the projection of the current value onto payload-provided keys) so edits to keys the payload does not set are not conflicts.

findings.issue: Rollback derives the rule key from the map key (substr($key,9)) but Validate never enforces key === 'redirect:'.from (build-payload only warns). A record with a non-conventional key removes/restores the wrong rule on rollback.
findings.fix: Enforce the key convention in Validate::check_shape (as done for term keys), or store the normalized 'from' in the map row and use it in rollback.

findings.issue: When a referenced file's parent directory does not exist, realpath(dirname) fails and null is returned, so Validate reports 'File reference ... escapes the payload directory' for a merely missing file (seen in my test run).
findings.fix: Return a distinct 'missing' result (or walk up to the nearest existing ancestor) so only true traversal is reported as escaping.

findings.issue: wp_insert_term(), wp_update_nav_menu_item() and update_post_meta('_wp_attachment_image_alt') are called with unslashed values; core unslashes, so names/titles/alt containing backslashes lose them (wp_update_term is correctly slashed).
findings.fix: wp_slash() the arguments (name/description, item_args(), alt) before those calls.

findings.issue: CLI commands are registered twice (Rest::register under WP_CLI and CLI\Commands::register); WP_CLI silently overwrites, but it is redundant and the Rest docblock claims a hk9_run_import cap that can() never checks.
findings.fix: Drop the WP_CLI block from Rest::register (Commands.php owns registration) and correct the docblock or check the capability.
